title: Run the production image as a non-root user

criteria.then: its runtime (final) stage declares a non-root USER, so `docker run --rm <image> id` is not uid 0

criteria.given: the Images workflow builds the UI image
criteria.then: it runs that image and fails when the runtime user is root (uid 0)

criteria.given: the app runs as uid 1000 with the compose volumes mounted
criteria.then: compose's one-shot ui-init service hands ${DATA_DIR}/ipfs and ${DATA_DIR}/packages to uid 1000 before ui starts, and the deployment docs say so

criteria.given: the change is confined to the production runtime image, compose and docs
criteria.then: the demo start and resume path is untouched: demo.sh still serves the app with `vite dev` (not the production image), so the Demo start and resume check keeps passing (it runs in CI)
